findings.description: Joanni Jacobo Clotten married Maria Magdalena Weber on 30 June 1716 in the diocese of Trier, Rhineland.
supporting_sources: Deutschland, Rheinland, Bistum Trier, katholische Kirchenbücher, 1543-1958 — entry for Joannes Jacobus Klotten and Maria Magdalena Weber, 30 Jun 1716

findings.description: The wife the tree records only as 'Mariae Magdalenae' had the surname Weber.

person.name: Maria Magdalena Weber
person.role: wife of Joanni Jacobo Clotten, mother of the 1717 and 1720 children

supporting_sources: Deutschland, Rheinland, Bistum Trier, katholische Kirchenbücher, 1543-1958 — marriage entry of 30 Jun 1716
